==Description==
The '''Strong Alien''' was the second [[enemy]] that spawned in [[Area 51]] as part of the [[Area 51 Event]]. It had the same speed as the [[Alien (Area 51)|Alien]], but had higher health.

==Appearance==
The '''Strong Alien''' was an extraterrestrial [[Enemies|enemy]] that had grey skin and a rounded grey alien head.

==Strategy==
*Similar to the [[Alien (Area 51)|Alien]], they can be killed with [[Crook Boss]]es or [[Minigunner]]s, though you may have to upgrade your current ones or buy new towers to cope with the '''Strong Alien's''' health.
*[[Rocketeer|Rocketer]]s and [[Demoman|Demomen]] can deal significant damage to hordes of '''Strong Aliens'''.

==Trivia==
*Similar to the [[Alien (Area 51)|Alien]], the '''Strong Alien''' was a reference to Area 51 conspiracy theories speculating that the US Government is hiding extraterrestrial proof in the military base.
*The '''Strong Alien's''' head was the {{RLinkC|13837194|Retro Gray Alien}} accessory in the Roblox catalog.
